Illusion.Name: Distracting Illusion
Illusion.EffectDescription: Attacks against this character gain a disadvantage and can't graze. Ends after an attack misses them, or at the end of the scene.
Illusion.Ended: An attack missed {target}: their Distracting Illusion ends.
Illusion.Disadvantage: Distracting Illusion on {names}: this attack has a disadvantage.
Illusion.AskOutcome: Did {attack} hit {target}? A miss ends their Distracting Illusion.

Error.unknown: That character or card can't be found.
Error.notOwner: Only the caster's owner can do that.
Error.notTargeted: That character wasn't part of the attack.
Error.notMissed: The attack hit, so the illusion stays.

Settings.Name: Automate Distracting Illusion
Settings.Hint: Mark the character a Distracting Illusion is cast on. Attacks against them start with a disadvantage and can't graze, and the mark is removed after an attack misses them or when the combat ends.
